Second development release of 0.18.0: Oxidized config backups for virtual routers, automatic Oxidized node sync, and fixes for the bugs reported against dev1.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.18.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.18.0 right.

Everything in [0.18.0-dev1](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev1) is included; read its notes for the full list, including the script sandbox default.

### Oxidized

- #384 - **Oxidized nodes can be linked to virtual machines,** so virtual routers and firewalls (MikroTik CHR, VyOS, virtual firewalls) get config backups, history and diffs like physical devices. Matching looks at devices and VMs together, the pin dialog offers both, and the VM's Config tab shows the backups. Reading a VM's config needs the new `view_config` permission on virtual machines, which no built-in role includes.
- #385 - **Automatic node sync:** each Oxidized connection can sync its nodes every 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minutes. New connections sync every 30 minutes; connections that existed before the upgrade stay off until you turn it on. The connection shows the last sync, the next one and the last error; **Sync nodes** still runs one at once.

### Fixed

- #386 - **Pinning an Oxidized node can no longer reveal another object's config.** Pinning and unlinking need change rights on the Oxidized connection, node links follow site scope, and a pin never gives you a config you couldn't already read.
- #387 - **Spreadsheet export no longer shows SLA service credits to users without `view_credits`;** export leaves out every column the API hides from you, and refuses to filter on it.
- #388 - **Import and export are refused for an integration that is switched off,** the same way the API refuses it.
- #389 - **Records created before 0.18 can be saved from their edit forms again.** The 0.18 rules run only when a field they depend on changes.
- #390 - **Changing a device type's height, depth or width is refused** when its racked devices would no longer fit or would overlap.
- #391 - **The bulk-delete preview counts the cables a delete removes,** and says whether each cable is kept or removed.
- #392 - **Swapping a cable's two ends in one edit works.**
- #393 - **The MAC address list loads in about 2 seconds at 20,000 MACs** (was over 11), and the site map, Ansible inventory, topology cards, compliance and alerts load tags the same faster way.

Thank you @SerhiiZahuba for the Oxidized reports and @deku-m for the bug reports.
